description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Changes only the CTA check settings sent: ctaLevel (off, warn, block), ctaPaidLevel (warn or block), organicSupportingHosts and autoApplyPrimaryCta. Only the brand's owners and admins can change them. Confirm changes with the person first. Free. Needs the Pro plan or higher.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/hook-studio/cta-settings.)

autoApplyPrimaryCta.description: Studio adds the primary CTA to a post with none. Default: true.

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key may omit it.

ctaLevel.description: The CTA check on organic posts. Default: warn.

ctaPaidLevel.description: The CTA check on paid posts, never off. Default: block.

organicSupportingHosts.description: Hosts an organic post may link to besides a goal. Default: the website, youtube.com, youtu.be, github.com.

name: cta_settings_update
title: Update CTA check settings
